sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Instrument pages: the IROMBOOK drawing MusicBrainz shows at the top of the sidebar now works like an artist's or label's sidebar picture — a hover card, a click (or Enter/Space) opens it in the artwork viewer, and a small copy leads the page heading on every instrument tab, before and after the table is loaded. The copy shows the whole drawing instead of cropping it, and the viewer bar has no Commons link (a drawing has no Commons page). Same switches: 'Sidebar picture: hover card and viewer' and 'Sidebar picture beside the name'.
